messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT — Elevated tool/function-call parser errors for tenant 'Miramar' (VPC-dedicated us-west2). Error rate spiked to ~18% over last 5m. Impact: generation requests hitting tool-calls are failing->client timeouts. Paging oncall.

Samir K: oncall here, ack. I'm looking at logs now. Samir K: @Jade O can you pull recent ingress logs and any recent deploys to runtime in us-west2?

Jade O: pulling logs. I see a surge of 502/500 from toolcall-parser service starting ~2219876300. Trace IDs show parse failures thrown from parse_tool_args(). Example raw payload excerpt:

Priya M: sharing likely cause — customer started sending multi-line tool args with an unescaped delimiter pipe (|) inside a single argument. Our line-based split assumes '||' separator. Example incoming body:

```
{"tool_name":"invoice_extractor","args":"item1|item2|customer:ACME|notes:needs\nreview"}
```

Priya M: parser treats first '|' as field separator and produces malformed JSON for downstream funcall ABI, hence serialization errors. This looks like schema drift on their side after they upgraded a client lib.

Jade O: confirmed. Parser stack traces:
```
ERROR parse_tool_args: invalid_token at char 12
stack: parse_tool_args -> deserialize_lines -> JSON.decode
```

Alan O'Neill: severity? Customer impact level? Miramar is on a reserved Dedicated pool. If hitting 18% error rate that's user-facing. We need tenant isolation and short-term fallback asap. Also notify account team.

Samir K: Severity P1 for Miramar (enterprise SLA). Notify CS and assigned AM now. I'm going to route Miramar traffic to the fallback model variant (redwood-serve-fallback) in the same pool to restore availability while we mitigate.

runtime-bot: Routing command accepted. Traffic-shift job 3621 queued. Estimated completion ~30s.

runtime-bot: Job 3621 completed — Miramar requests now routed to redwood-serve-fallback in us-west2. Error rate dropped to ~1.2% within 90s. :thumbsup:

customer-support: Notified Miramar via email + phone. Ticket MIR-2026-819 created and linked. CS note: "We've routed you to a safer model variant while we investigate parser failures; engineering will follow up with a remediation plan."

Priya M: suggested mitigation options:
- quick shim at ingress to escape/encode '|' and control-newlines inside tool args (fast, low-risk)
- update parser to tolerant mode (accept pipes inside quoted args) — requires runtime change and careful testing
- ask customer to patch client (longer term)

Jade O: I can deploy ingress-escape-shim as a config patch to the dedicated pool config. Small Lua filter we use for edge transforms. Will roll canary to 5% of Miramar traffic first.

Samir K: go for it. Keep canary small until we confirm no regression.

Jade O: applying canary now. Command:
```
kubectl patch configmap pool-us-west2-miramar --patch '{"data":{"edge_filter":"escape_pipe_v1"}}'
```

runtime-bot: Patch applied to canary nodes (2/40). Observing telemetry.

Jade O: canary looks good at 5m. Errors on canary nodes 0.5%. Rolling to 50%.

Priya M: while patch rolls, I'll open a runtime issue to add a tolerant parser mode and a unit test covering embedded delimiters. Ticket: RT-4529.

Alan O'Neill: assign RT-4529 to eng-runtime and eng-ml for triage. Please include perf/regression guard. We can't risk slower parse path for all tenants.

Samir K: handoff plan — I'll stay for handover to Jade at 2219877400. After Jade confirms full roll and customer acknowledgement, we'll close the emergency route.

Jade O: full roll complete at 2219877365. Error rate steady at 0.7%. Rolling back fallback routing to normal model (gradual 10% steps).

runtime-bot: Routing rollback job 3628 started.

runtime-bot: Routing rollback job 3628 completed. Miramar back on primary model variant. Error rate stable ~1.1% (within baseline for Miramar workloads). Monitoring.

customer-support: Miramar acknowledged and accepted mitigation. CS will schedule a post-incident follow-up meeting with the customer next week. Ticket MIR-2026-819 updated.

Samir K: postmortem notes to capture:
- root cause: customer client began emitting unescaped '|' in tool args, causing parser split -> malformed funcall payloads
- immediate mitigation: route to fallback model variant + ingress-escape-shim canary+rollout
- long-term fix: tolerant parser mode + client communication + add canned test to evals for funcall arg edgecases
- action owners: Jade -> ingress shim (closed), Priya -> RT-4529 (in progress), Alan -> SLA/customer comms

Alan O'Neill: handing over to Jade for next-day follow-ups. Good job team. :white_check_mark:

Jade O: taking over. I'll own the postmortem write-up and attach timeline + logs. Will coordinate with Priya on RT-4529 definition and QA steps.

Samir K: thanks all. Closing incident channel once postmortem draft is uploaded."
